title: Admin safety gate references deleted BZA classes and obsolete immutable-history parity
actual: After the F182 transaction assertion passes, the same gate fails because cpf-backoffice/.../BzaBackofficeService.java is absent.
rootCause: The broad gate was not currentized with the completed BZA retirement. It still owns BzaBackofficeService/BzaBusinessAuditService/BzaBackofficeController identifiers and BZA messages, and it repeats the invalid Source/central V61-V63 byte-equality assumption already repaired in the dedicated F181 verifier.
repair: All active paths, identifiers and messages now use Backoffice owners. The broad gate delegates independent V61-V63 manifest/published-hash and exact rollback validation to check-data-safety-schema-contract.ps1, while retaining current Source assertions, generated lifecycle parity, raw PII, masking, inline-SQL, query-contract and official DB3 readiness gates. Historical bza filenames remain only as immutable version identities.
repairPlan: Rerun the full gate and its regression through all downstream checks before closure.
falseGreenForbidden: Do not restore deleted BZA classes, rewrite immutable history, skip raw PII/audit/inline-SQL checks, or remove downstream readiness gates.
